identity.note: This is the Project Engineering Baseline ratified by project decision. It is NOT a reproduction of the GazeHub ResNet-50 MPIIFaceGaze baseline: the authoritative public sources do not publish that training recipe.

loss.target_handling: gaze label used exactly as produced by preprocessing (unit vector); cast to float32 at the loss boundary only; predictions stay raw/unnormalized
loss.source: training/trainer.py documented inference from appearance-based regression convention; no authoritative source specifies it

optimizer.source: TrainingConfig defaults in training/trainer.py; betas/eps/amsgrad recorded here explicitly because they are torch.optim.Adam library defaults (listed to prevent hidden settings)

scheduler.source: no repository specification requires one; deliberately absent

epochs.scope: TrainingConfig default; real runs may raise it via configuration without changing this frozen default

seed.mechanism: ExperimentConfig.seed / TrainingConfig.seed honored via apply_seed(python+numpy+torch) at trainer construction; fully reproducible init requires seeding before model construction
seed.source: seed mechanism required by existing experiment schema; default intentionally unset

pretrained_initialization.verified_part: the request pretrained_backbone=true is VERIFIED / SOURCE-BACKED (models/registry.py params)
pretrained_initialization.project_chosen_part: the concrete torchvision weight version is PROJECT-CHOSEN / NOT AUTHORITATIVE

checkpoint.policy: minimal manual save/load via BaselineTrainer.save_checkpoint / load_checkpoint (model+optimizer state, epoch, history)

shuffling.loader_behavior: DataLoader shuffle=False unless a caller explicitly overrides for training
shuffling.source: existing DataLoader behavior preserved unchanged; dataset itself never reorders samples

evaluation_protocol.value: leave-one-person-out: 15 deterministic folds over subjects p00-p14, each subject held out exactly once; within-fold train/test sample-ID disjointness enforced

model_contract.source: models/registry.py inputs/outputs contract; angular-error evaluator normalizes predictions internally

authoritative_external_source.value: GazeHub @ Phi-ai Lab (https://phi-ai.buaa.edu.cn/Gazehub/) - Cheng et al., TPAMI 2024 (arXiv:2104.12668)
authoritative_external_source.caveat: identifies protocol/preprocessing authority only; it does NOT publish the ResNet-50 MPIIFaceGaze optimization recipe
